name: Event
definition: A scheduled activity organized by the student club, such as a meeting, game, speaker event, election, social, registration, or community-service activity.

name: Member
definition: An individual recorded as a member of the student club, including officers and members marked inactive.
scope: Member-centric analysis of the club roster.

name: Academic Major
definition: An academic degree program offered by a university department within a college.

name: ZIP Code Area
definition: A postal ZIP code area carrying associated place, county, and state attributes.
scope: Geographic analysis of member home locations.

name: Budget Line
definition: A budgeted allocation for one expense category of one event, recording allocated amount, amount spent, remaining amount, and the event lifecycle status.

name: Expense
definition: A recorded expenditure incurred by a member against a budget line, with a description, date, cost, and approval flag.

name: Attendance Record
definition: A record that one member attended one event.

name: Event Name
definition: The human-readable name of an event, such as Yearly Kickoff, October Meeting, or Women's Soccer.

name: Event Date
definition: The scheduled date and time of an event.

name: Event Type
definition: The category of club activity an event represents, such as Meeting, Game, Guest Speaker, Election, Social, Community Service, Registration, or Budget.

name: Event Lifecycle Status
definition: The lifecycle status recorded on the event itself: Closed, Open, or Planning. A closed event is one whose status is Closed.
scope: Filtering events by lifecycle stage, especially identifying closed events.

name: Budget Event Status
definition: The lifecycle status of an event repeated on each of that event's budget rows: Closed, Open, or Planning.
scope: Filtering budget rows by the lifecycle status of the owning event.

name: Member Given Name
definition: The given (first) name of a member.

name: Member Family Name
definition: The family (last) name of a member.

name: Member Full Name
definition: The complete personal name of a member, formed by combining the given-name component and the family-name component.
scope: Referring to members by personal name in questions and reports.

name: Member Position
definition: The role held by a member within the club, such as President, Vice President, Secretary, Treasurer, Member, or Inactive.

name: Member Phone Number
definition: The contact telephone number of a member.

name: T-Shirt Size
definition: The apparel size of the club t-shirt worn by a member: Small, Medium, Large, or X-Large.
scope: Club apparel planning and member attribute analysis.

name: Member Major Reference
definition: The reference from a member to that member's declared academic major. A member may have no declared major.

name: Member Home ZIP Reference
definition: The reference from a member to the ZIP code area of the member's home location.

name: Major Name
definition: The name of an academic major, such as Finance or Business.

name: Major Department
definition: The department or school that offers an academic major.
scope: Reporting the department associated with a member's major.

name: City
definition: The city or place name associated with a ZIP code area.

name: County
definition: The county or municipio name associated with a ZIP code area.

name: State
definition: The full name of the state or territory associated with a ZIP code area.

name: State Abbreviation
definition: The two-letter postal abbreviation of the state associated with a ZIP code area.

name: Budget Category
definition: The expense category to which a budget line is allocated, such as Advertisement, Food, Parking, Speaker Gifts, or Club T-Shirts.

name: Expense Description
definition: The free-text description of what an expense purchased, used as the kind or type of expense, such as Pizza, Posters, or Water, Cookies.
scope: Classifying and grouping expenses by purchased item.

name: Expense Date
definition: The calendar date on which an expense was incurred, stored as a ten-character calendar date in year-month-day order.
scope: Temporal analysis of expenses, including month-based filtering.

name: Expense Approval Flag
definition: The approval marker on an expense record; the observed value true indicates an approved expense.

name: Expense Cost
definition: The monetary amount of a single expense record.

name: Budget Spent Amount
definition: The amount already spent against a budget line.
scope: Spending analysis at budget-line or event level.

name: Budget Allocated Amount
definition: The total amount allocated to a budget line before spending.

name: Budget Remaining Amount
definition: The unspent portion of a budget line, equal to the allocated amount minus the spent amount. A negative value indicates spending beyond the allocation.

name: Spend-to-Budget Ratio
definition: The ratio of amount spent to amount allocated for a budget line, or for an event's aggregate budget when summed across its budget lines.
scope: Comparing spending intensity across events or categories.

name: Budget Overrun
definition: The amount by which spending exceeds the allocated budget for a budget line or event; positive when over budget and equal to the magnitude of a negative remaining amount.
scope: Identifying events or categories that exceeded their budget.

name: Attendance Count
definition: The number of members recorded as attending an event, equal to the number of attendance records for that event.

name: Total Expense Cost
definition: The sum of expense costs across a set of expense records, such as all expenses of an event or of a member.
scope: Aggregate spending by event, member, or description.

name: Average Expense Cost
definition: The arithmetic mean of expense costs across a set of expense records.
scope: Comparing individual expense records against typical spending.
